text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Turbo engine... total 
combustion...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After praising Twin Turbo for powering 
through today's training, I was about to 
pack up when—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you were really flying out there 
again today~! Just watching you got me so 
excited.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yo! First-class athlete! I oughta take a 
page from your book~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! If you wanna learn, I'll show you 
more of Turbo's running!
choice_data_list: I want to see it too!
I want to see it too!
I might end up overworking myself...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! If you wanna learn, I'll show you 
more of Turbo's running!
choice_data_list: I want to see it too!
I want to see it too!
I might end up overworking myself...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"That fearless, all-out running of hers... 
it's amazing... If only an ordinary girl 
like me had a personality like that—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: “—Turbo! I'm gonna run with you too~!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Twin Turbo and Machikane 
Tannhauser happily continued their tandem 
run together.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~~!! Turbo wants to run, wants to 
run, wants to run!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you what top-class looks 
like--!!
choice_data_list:
A top-class athlete rests like a top-class 
athlete.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Even when resting, my turbo engine is at 
full throttle! Trainer! Machitan! Let's 
go-o-o!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Teach me how to take an 
extraordinary break!
